decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly mill the opponent's library using cards like Archive Trap, Hedron Crab, and Ruin Crab while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Drown in the Loch and removal like Fatal Push. Tasha's Hideous Laughter and Fractured Sanity provide additional mill options, with Surgical Extraction being used to remove key cards from the opponent's graveyard. The deck also includes some card draw with Visions of Beyond and Preordain, as well as land destruction with Field of Ruin and Undercity Sewers. Overall, the deck aims to win by milling the opponent out before they can execute their own win condition.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana using cards like Ruby Medallion and Pyretic Ritual, and then chain together spells with Past in Flames to produce a large storm count. This allows for a big Grapeshot finish to deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and filtering effects like Reckless Impulse and Glimpse the Impossible to help find combo pieces. Ral, Monsoon Mage can also provide additional card advantage and help with dealing damage. Wish and Valakut Awakening add versatility and flexibility to the deck.

Utilize a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to control the game and disrupt your opponent's strategy. Generate incremental value with powerful card draw engines like Snapcaster Mage and Tune the Narrative, while also having access to efficient removal options like Prismatic Ending and Galvanic Discharge. Finish the game with powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Wrath of the Skies. The deck aims to outlast and outvalue opponents in a grindy game of attrition, ultimately coming out on top through careful resource management and strategic planning.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Pyretic Ritual and Ruby Medallion to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wish. It uses Glimpse the Impossible and Reckless Impulse to dig for combo pieces and Past in Flames to recur spells from the graveyard. Wrenn's Resolve helps protect the combo pieces while Valakut Awakening and Artist's Talent provide card advantage. The deck aims to win the game through a storm mechanic, casting multiple spells in a turn to overwhelm the opponent and deal lethal damage.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures with high power and evasion to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to control the game and protect its threats. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support to the aggressive strategy, maximizing the damage output. Consign to Memory offers card advantage and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can help close out games quickly. The mana base is designed to support the multiple colors required for the powerful creatures and spells in the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to accelerate mana production and enable explosive plays with Primeval Titan, fetching powerful lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva. The deck also includes cards like Scapeshift and Green Sun's Zenith to search for key combo pieces, with support from cards like Arboreal Grazer and Simic Growth Chamber to ensure smooth mana production. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with massive threats and versatile land plays.

This deck focuses on using aggressive Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls, the deck can play its powerful creatures ahead of curve and protect them from counterspells. Cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths disrupt the opponent's strategy, while cards like All Is Dust and Glaring Fleshraker can clear the board for a final push. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Wastescape Battlemage to control the pace of the game and secure victory through relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on accelerating mana production using ramp spells and lands to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures. The goal is to control the game with disruptive spells like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command, while also utilizing Eldrazi abilities to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Emrakul, the Promised End provides additional win conditions and powerful board control. By ramping up mana quickly and controlling the battlefield with Eldrazi creatures, this deck aims to dominate the late game and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to create a powerful combo utilizing cards like Glaring Fleshraker, Writhing Chrysalis, and Basking Broodscale to gain an advantage over the opponent. By playing Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Thought-Knot Seer, along with support cards such as Urza's Saga and Cavern of Souls, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence. The inclusion of cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble adds versatility and control elements to the deck, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matchups.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counter spells, and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Force of Negation, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and prevent the opponent from executing their strategy effectively. The deck also includes creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus to apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the board. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent while utilizing the blink mechanic to generate value from entering the battlefield triggers. By combining aggressive creatures like Aven Interrupter and Emperor of Bones with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and disrupt their game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provides additional control and removal options to keep the opponent on the back foot. The land base is optimized for consistent mana fixing to ensure smooth gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and using blink effects to repeatedly generate value from entering the battlefield triggers. By combining aggressive threats with the ability to protect them and disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and maintain control of the board. The deck also includes hand disruption and removal spells to keep the opponent off balance. The combination of aggressive creatures, blink effects, and disruptive elements creates a versatile and resilient deck that can adapt to various matchups.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts and overwhelming the opponent with threats. By using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga to generate value and mana acceleration, the deck can efficiently play out its threats and disrupt the opponent with counter magic like Metallic Rebuke. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Cori-Steel Cutter provide additional card advantage and pressure, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Pinnacle Emissary offer value and card selection. The combination of aggressive creatures, efficient removal with Galvanic Blast, and disruptive elements creates a powerful aggro strategy that aims to win the game quickly.

Utilize instant speed reanimation spells to quickly cheat out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ulamog. Use cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to bring back big threats from the graveyard during your opponent's end step. Control the board with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, while disrupting your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. Make use of creatures with strong enter the battlefield effects, like Fallaji Archaeologist and Psychic Frog, to gain additional value and outvalue your opponent in the late game.

The main concept of this deck is to use creatures that have beneficial enter-the-battlefield effects ("Blink" effects) in combination with cards that can flicker or exile them temporarily, allowing you to repeatedly trigger those effects. By doing so, you can generate card advantage, gain life, and disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck also includes efficient removal spells to deal with threats on the other side of the battlefield. Overall, it aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and value generation.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and utilizing powerful spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls provide efficient threats, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Cosmogrand Zenith offer additional ways to push damage through. Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing the deck to maintain control of the battlefield. The deck's mana base enables quick and consistent plays, ensuring a fast and relentless assault on the opponent's life total.
